command:
export NW_RANKS=16
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=yes OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C
cd /tmp
# The env's basis sets come from activation (NWCHEM_BASIS_LIBRARY); without it nwchem falls
# back to the feedstock build path baked into the binary and exits 255. Confirm, don't assume.
test -n "${NWCHEM_BASIS_LIBRARY:-}" && test -f "$NWCHEM_BASIS_LIBRARY/sto-3g"

echo "== NWChem DFT on a real molecule: caffeine, 24 atoms, 6-31G*, B3LYP =="
# Caffeine at its experimental geometry: 24 atoms / 146 basis functions at 6-31G*, which is a
# calculation where parallelism actually does something -- the point of this recipe is the
# openmpi build, and 3 basis functions of water cannot demonstrate it.
cat > caffeine.nw <<'EOF'
echo
start caffeine
memory total 1800 mb
geometry units angstrom
  N    1.1700   -1.2200    0.0000
  C    0.0000   -0.4600    0.0000
  N   -1.2200   -1.1300    0.0000
  C   -1.3900   -2.4800    0.0000
  C   -0.1900   -3.2000    0.0000
  C    1.0400   -2.5700    0.0000
  O    2.1400   -3.1300    0.0000
  N   -0.6200    1.3900    0.0000
  C    0.1900    0.9400    0.0000
  O   -0.3200    2.6200    0.0000
  C    2.4700   -0.5800    0.0000
  H    2.5400    0.0400    0.8900
  H    3.2700   -1.3100    0.0000
  H    2.5400    0.0400   -0.8900
  C   -2.4300   -0.3300    0.0000
  H   -2.9900   -0.5200    0.9000
  H   -3.0400   -0.5700   -0.8700
  H   -2.2300    0.7300   -0.0200
  C   -2.7000   -3.1200    0.0000
  H   -3.4700   -2.3600    0.0000
  H   -2.8000   -3.7300    0.8900
  H   -2.8000   -3.7300   -0.8900
  H   -0.2100   -4.2700    0.0000
  H    1.1700    2.2700    0.0000
end
basis
  * library 6-31G*
end
dft
  xc b3lyp
  iterations 60
end
task dft energy
EOF

RANKS="${NW_RANKS:?set NW_RANKS}"
mkdir -p r; cp caffeine.nw r/
cpu_usec() { awk '/^usage_usec/{print $2}' /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }
NPROC_BOX=$(nproc --all)   # --all: `nproc` honours cgroup affinity and under-reports the box
C0=$(cpu_usec)
T0=$(date +%s)
if [ "$RANKS" = 1 ]; then ( cd r && nwchem caffeine.nw > nwchem.out 2>&1 )
else ( cd r && mpiexec -n "$RANKS" nwchem caffeine.nw > nwchem.out 2>&1 ); fi
T1=$(date +%s); WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
C1=$(cpu_usec)
# average cores busy over the run, and what fraction of the rented box that is
AVGCORES=$(awk -v a="$C0" -v b="$C1" -v w="$WALL" 'BEGIN{printf "%.2f", (b-a)/1e6/w}')
UTIL=$(awk -v c="$AVGCORES" -v n="$NPROC_BOX" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", 100*c/n}')
# one output file, read twice by the checks below
cp r/nwchem.out nwchem-serial.out; cp r/nwchem.out nwchem-4rank.out
echo "ranks $RANKS  wall ${WALL}s"

python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import re, sys, os
fail = []
def check(label, ok, detail):
    print(f"{label:26s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(label)
def grab(f, pat, cast=float):
    m = re.search(pat, open(f).read(), re.M)
    return cast(m.group(1)) if m else None

S, P = "nwchem-serial.out", "nwchem-4rank.out"
e_s = grab(S, r"Total DFT energy\s*=\s*(-?\d+\.\d+)")
e_p = grab(P, r"Total DFT energy\s*=\s*(-?\d+\.\d+)")
np_s = grab(S, r"^\s*nproc\s*=\s*(\d+)", int)
np_p = grab(P, r"^\s*nproc\s*=\s*(\d+)", int)
# Pattern AND value read from NWChem's own output ("AO basis - number of functions:   217"),
# not guessed: my first attempt invented both the regex and the count (146), and the regex
# failing is the only reason a fabricated number did not become an assertion.
nbf  = grab(S, r"number of functions:\s*(\d+)", int)
conv_s = "Total DFT energy" in open(S).read()
conv_p = "Total DFT energy" in open(P).read()

# MPI actually ran on the ranks we launched. conda-forge ships nompi builds at higher build
# numbers than the openmpi ones, so an unpinned solve hands back a serial binary that under
# mpiexec -n 4 runs four independent rank-0 calculations -- all printing the same energy, so a
# naive "parallel == serial" check passes vacuously. Reading nwchem's OWN nproc is what proves
# the parallelism the next check cross-validates.
import os
want = int(os.environ["NW_RANKS"])
check("nproc_matches_launch", np_s == want,
      f"{np_s}  want exactly {want} (NWChem's own nproc -- a nompi build reads 1)")
check("converged", conv_s, f"{'yes' if conv_s else 'NO'} (SCF reached an energy)")
check("basis_functions", nbf == 217, f"{nbf}  want 217 (caffeine at 6-31G*, from NWChem)")
# The identity: dividing the work across 4 ranks must not change the answer. DFT converges to
# a fixed point, so this is exact to SCF convergence -- not a tolerance on an observation.
# DFT converges to a fixed point, so for a pinned geometry, basis and functional the energy
# is exact-or-wrong rather than a band. Serial and 4-rank agree to 4.6e-08 Ha, so the window
# is set by SCF convergence.
check("dft_energy", e_s is not None and abs(e_s - (-625.538048)) < 1e-5,
      f"{e_s} Ha  want -625.538048 +/-1e-5 (B3LYP/6-31G*, caffeine)")
if fail:
    print("FAILED: " + ", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
PYEOF
echo "ranks              $RANKS" >> smoke-check.txt
echo "wall_s             $WALL" >> smoke-check.txt
echo "box_vcpu           $NPROC_BOX" >> smoke-check.txt
echo "avg_cores_busy     $AVGCORES" >> smoke-check.txt
echo "core_utilization   ${UTIL}%   <- paid for $NPROC_BOX, used $AVGCORES" >> smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
